doc: A kind of gate in a wall (design/planner.md, Gates), as a config entry: a log gate in a palisade, a town gate's arch, a gatehouse with towers and a portcullis, a tower gate, or a postern, with its doors, roof, and what it shows. It takes the wall's kind, so it matches the wall it stands in.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: How it is built: a gate (two leaves between posts or piers, the wall's own height), an arch (an arched opening through a raised section of the wall), a gatehouse (two towers either side of a vaulted passage, a portcullis), a tower gate (a tower over the passage), or a postern (a small door).

fields.name: rise
fields.doc: How far it rises above the wall, metres.

fields.name: depth
fields.doc: How deep its passage is, as a multiple of the wall's thickness.

fields.name: roof
fields.doc: Its top: none (crenellated as the wall), a cone, a pyramid, or a gable.
